name: 皮肤纹理时间分析
description: 检查视频帧中皮肤纹理的一致性和微细节保留。
useCase: Detecting AI生成的 faces through temporal skin texture 异常
mechanism: 分析 pore-level skin texture, wrinkle 模式, and micro-surface details 跨 consecutive frames. AI生成的 faces often show unnatural smoothness, texture flickering, or inconsistent skin detail levels that vary 之间 frames.
accuracy: 高 - 80-90% on face generation 深度伪造s
source: Li, L. et al. (2020) - Face X-Ray for More General Face Forgery Detection, CVPR
algorithm: Texture Feature Extraction (LBP/Gabor) + Temporal Coherence + Statistical Analysis
parameters: Patch size: 32x32, Features: LBP, Gabor magnitude, Texture 梯度, Frame window: 15
